verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents embedded AI features that take on narrow tasks. The AI Editor builds and edits ingestion workflows from natural-language prompts, Sprinto AI validates uploaded evidence and flags gaps, and AI-assisted due diligence reviews are supported. None of these amounts to a general-purpose assistant that users can hand arbitrary in-product tasks to, and the GitHub compliance-skills are external agent add-ons, not a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: a general conversational assistant inside the product, delegation across modules (policies, risks, access reviews), multi-step agentic task execution, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
